about: Loop workflows the watchdog expects to be enabled. If GitHub disables one for inactivity, the watchdog re-enables it. One disabled by hand is reported as off and left alone. ledger, perf-baselines, chaos-soak and publish-results are the capture workflows (design audit H8). `external` lists workflows of other repositories (repo, path, why) the watchdog reports on; the nightly conformance and every enabled lane's workflow file are always included (watchdog/lanes.mjs).
